grid_carbon_intensity.notes: Operational carbon intensity of grid electricity (gCO2eq/kWh). global_average after IEA (2023); us_average after US EPA eGRID; eu_average after EEA; low_carbon_france after RTE/EEA. Used to convert measured CPU package energy to CO2eq; DRAM/GPU and embodied carbon are excluded.

notes: Final energy measurement must run on a controlled Linux machine with Intel RAPL. Colab/shared environments are only for dataset validation and development.
